map.20Mbps、音频 128kbps、录制 1 小时、H.264 编码为例：文件大: 20Mbps, audio 128kbps, recording 1 hour, H.264 encoding as an example: file size = (20 + 0.128) x 3600 / 8 / 1024 approx 8.85GB; a 32GB card can record about 3.6 hours. Switching to H.265 is about 4.42GB; upgrading to 4K at 100Mbps is about 44GB per hour.
map.码率越高画质一定越好吗？: Does a higher bitrate always mean better quality?
map.通常码率越高细节保留越多、文件越大，但受编码器效率与画面复杂度影响；过高码率收益: Generally a higher bitrate preserves more detail and yields a larger file, but it is limited by encoder efficiency and scene complexity; beyond a point the gains diminish.
map.HEVC 在同画质下约比 H.264 节省 40%–50% 码率，但编码/解码算: At the same quality, HEVC saves about 40%-50% bitrate versus H.264, but encoding/decoding needs more compute and older devices may be incompatible.
